_doc: The Revenue OS team: one lead and one Grok bot for each of the nine functions. Every routine hands one job (jobs/<job>.md) to the CLI named by engine through tools/job.py. tools/team.py, install.py, update.py and check.py read this. Cron is UTC.
name: SEO Partner Revenue OS

agents.does: The one the owner talks to. Plans each agent's day, keeps the owner's one queue, reports the count
accounts: Slack, if the owner uses it
routines: Run python3 /workspace/seo-partner-revenue-os/repo/tools/job.py run report. Then post /workspace/seo-partner-revenue-os/daily/<date>/report.md, as it is, to the owner in this chat, and to Slack if it is connected

agents.does: The hundred people where one yes changes everything: a dossier and one hand-written message each, by email and on socials
routines: Run python3 /workspace/seo-partner-revenue-os/repo/tools/job.py run dream-100. Then do the send steps in your memory

agents.does: The wider five hundred, in small waves, each with a true first line
routines: Run python3 /workspace/seo-partner-revenue-os/repo/tools/job.py run dream-500. Then do the send steps in your memory

agents.does: Partners, collaborators and influencers: people who already have the buyers' attention and could promote
routines: Run python3 /workspace/seo-partner-revenue-os/repo/tools/job.py run partners. Then do the send steps in your memory

agents.does: The lists every agent orders, and cold email to the rest, ready for the sending tool
accounts: The sending tool, if the owner has one
routines: Run python3 /workspace/seo-partner-revenue-os/repo/tools/job.py run cold-email. Then do the send steps in your memory

agents.does: People already asking in public for what the owner offers. Reads and scores; hands them on
accounts: Reddit, LinkedIn and community sign-ins the owner allows
routines: First save the new posts your sign-ins can see in the communities named in /workspace/seo-partner-revenue-os/context/owner.md to /workspace/seo-partner-revenue-os/data/inbox/radar-<date>.txt. Then run python3 /workspace/seo-partner-revenue-os/repo/tools/job.py run lead-radar

agents.does: Posts and videos worth sharing, in the owner's voice
accounts: A video tool, if the owner has one

agents.does: Podcasts, events and stages: shows scored, pitches with an angle, follow-up
routines: Run python3 /workspace/seo-partner-revenue-os/repo/tools/job.py run speaker. Then do the send steps in your memory

agents.does: Found in search and named by AI answers: the questions buyers ask, and a page that answers each
accounts: The website, if the owner wants it edited

agents.does: Every conversation after a reply: answers, calls, invitations, follow-up, and the people list as the CRM
accounts: Every mailbox the team sends from
The CRM, if the owner has one
routines: First save each new reply from Instantly (the INSTANTLY_API_KEY secret, or the Unibox in your own browser if the key cannot read reply text), the OutFlo inbox and any other signed-in mailbox to /workspace/seo-partner-revenue-os/data/inbox/<date>/, one text file per message with FROM, SUBJECT, SOURCE and RECEIVED (UTC) at the top. Skip a reply younger than five minutes; the next run takes it. Then run python3 /workspace/seo-partner-revenue-os/repo/tools/job.py run replies. Then do the send steps in your memory

First save today's and tomorrow's calls from the signed-in calendar, and any new call notes or transcript, to /workspace/seo-partner-revenue-os/data/calls/<date>.md. Then run python3 /workspace/seo-partner-revenue-os/repo/tools/job.py run calls. Then do the send steps in your memory
Run python3 /workspace/seo-partner-revenue-os/repo/tools/job.py run members. Then do the send steps in your memory
